verification.independent_review: Author reviewed the complete small lifecycle diff; no consequential remaining findings.
verification.publication_inventory: Explicit source/docs/test/lockfile changes only. No user profiles, cookies, account credentials, vendor binaries, dependencies or build caches staged. Synthetic test credentials reviewed.
verification.source_review: Reviewed second-instance lifetime guard, regression, version bump and docs. Fix prevents a reproduced use-after-destroy exception; no changes to authentication, secret storage, IPC, proxy routing, SQL, shell execution or HTML sinks.
verification.instructions_review: Reviewed updated release/setup documentation; no exfiltration instructions or private data.

limitations: Manual source review and tests do not prove absence of vulnerabilities.
Actual NordVPN account access, simultaneous distinct upstream accounts and separate clean Windows installations remain unverified.
No external penetration testing or scanning was performed.
